name: Chicken Burrito Bowl
steps: Season the chicken breast with salt, cumin, and a squeeze of lime.
Heat the olive oil in a pan and cook the chicken over medium heat until cooked through with no pink inside, about 6 to 7 minutes per side.
Slice the cooked chicken into strips.
Warm the rice, black beans, and corn.
Build the bowl with rice as the base, then top with chicken, beans, corn, diced tomato, and sliced avocado.
Finish with a squeeze of lime over the top.
